D: Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by three ghosts on Christmas Eve in this motion-capture take on the Dickens story.
P: Serve the main when Scrooge sends the prize turkey to the Cratchits.
S: Fezziwig's ball pork and sage rolls

Little puff pastry sausage rolls filled with pork, sage and apple, glazed golden and served warm with a sharp mustard and apple chutney. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, 2 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll and seal underneath. Brush with 1 beaten egg and cut each into 5 small rolls. Bake at 200C for 22 minutes until golden. Serve warm with 150g apple chutney stirred with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard.
the snowy streets of Victorian London

Hot roasted chestnuts tossed in nutty brown butter, rosemary and sea salt, served in paper cones like a London street stall. Cut a cross through the shell on the flat side of 600g fresh chestnuts. Soak in water for 10 minutes, then drain. Roast on a tray at 200C for 20 to 25 minutes until the shells peel back. Wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes, then peel while warm. Melt 40g butter until golden brown and nutty, add a sprig of chopped rosemary and toss the chestnuts through with sea salt. Serve in paper cones.
M: Scrooge's prize turkey with sage stuffing
the prize turkey Scrooge sends to the Cratchits

Butter-roasted turkey breast with sage and onion stuffing, apple sauce, roast potatoes and a rich gravy, a feast for the Cratchits. Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast with 40g butter, salt and pepper and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Mix 150g breadcrumbs, 1 diced onion fried in 30g butter, 2 tbsp chopped sage and 1 egg, press into a dish and bake for the last 30 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes in oil alongside. Simmer 3 peeled diced apples with 2 tbsp sugar and water until soft. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock.
W: A rich steamed fruit pudding with a sprig of holly on top, served in wedges with thick homemade custard and brandy butter cream. Steam an 800g Christmas pudding over simmering water for 1 hour, or follow the packet. Warm 500ml milk with 100ml cream. Whisk 4 egg yolks, 60g caster sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour, pour in the milk while whisking, return to the pan and stir until thick. Add 1 tsp vanilla. Whip 200ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and 1 tsp orange zest. Turn out the pudding, top with a holly sprig and serve with both.
K: Scrooge promising Bob a bowl of smoking bishop

An alcohol-free take on Dickens's hot punch: roasted clove-studded oranges warmed with red grape juice, cinnamon and honey. Stud 2 oranges with 6 cloves each and roast at 200C for 20 minutes until browned. Slice them into a saucepan with 1L red grape juice, 250ml apple juice, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 tbsp honey and 3 slices fresh ginger. Heat gently for 15 minutes without boiling. Ladle into heatproof glasses or mugs with an orange slice in each.
